outline: In the rapidly advancing digital age and knowledge economy, service innovation emerges as an effective way of transforming the way organizations engage with customers. This course introduces innovation theory and technology evolution. Through technology-driven applications,  service innovation can be enhanced and improved, and eventually benefit the competiveness and effectiveness for enterprises and consumers.
schedule:
Wee 1~4  Innovation theory
Wee 5~8  Technology evolution
Wee 9~18  Case Studies in Service Innovation
assessment:
Term paper 40%
Attendance and class performance 60%
